title.en: Diesel 30 Concrete Pump filed under the headings taken from Garden hose
title.zh: 柴油30型混凝土泵：章节取自《Garden hose》

description.en: Diesel 30 Concrete Pump is restated under Garden hose. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Diesel 30 Concrete Pump. The published table prints Diesel Engine (Power) 4105 / 56 kW; Theoretical Output 15 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 20 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.3 m³; Pumping Distance (H / V) 60 m / 180 m; Max. Aggregate Size 3 cm and below; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm; Main Unit Weight 2000 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 柴油30型混凝土泵放在《Garden hose》的结构下重述。邢台河北品锦机械公布柴油30型混凝土泵。已公布参数表印有：柴油机功率4105 / 56 kW；理论输送量15 m³/h；最大出口压力20 MPa；料斗容积0.3 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直）60 m / 180 m；最大骨料粒径3 cm and below；外形尺寸4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm；整机重量2000 kg。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
